items.claim: inhibin is high and FSH is low because Sertoli cells are overactive
items.correction: Sertoli cell dysfunction lowers inhibin B, reducing negative feedback and raising FSH.

items.claim: overexpression of E-cadherin, which makes its cells grow in single-file lines
items.correction: Invasive lobular carcinoma typically loses E-cadherin expression; reduced cell adhesion produces the single-file growth pattern.

items.claim: A complete hydatidiform mole is triploid (69,XXY) and usually contains fetal parts
items.correction: A complete mole is usually androgenetic diploid (46,XX or 46,XY) and lacks fetal tissue. A partial mole is often triploid and may contain fetal tissue.

items.claim: Hypocalcemia after thyroidectomy is caused by injury to the recurrent laryngeal nerve
items.correction: Hypocalcemia results from damage to or removal of the parathyroid glands. Recurrent laryngeal nerve injury causes vocal cord dysfunction.

items.claim: urine concentrates during water deprivation and does not respond to desmopressin
items.correction: In central diabetes insipidus, urine remains dilute during water deprivation and concentrates after desmopressin.

items.claim: treated with a beta-blocker first and an alpha-blocker second
items.correction: Establish alpha blockade before adding a beta-blocker if needed; beta blockade first can cause unopposed alpha-mediated vasoconstriction.
